items.title: Port complete body schema and interpolation to Rust
items.body:
The complete Rust body schema now covers all 17 variant sections. Original-native comparisons pass for all 28 vendor bodies plus a synthetic fixture, with 748 bit-exact pickup-normalization comparisons and 600 matching interpolation-routing plans. This issue remains open for actual per-field coefficient blending and final interpolated-output agreement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Type all remaining body-variant fields and document the complete serialized layout without inventing unknown DSP semantics.
- [x] Verify full typed serialization and native pickup-position normalization, including bodies without a middle pickup.
- [x] Recover all interpolation modes and verify nested triangle/bilinear routing and float32 weights against native instructions.
- [ ] Implement actual InterpolateBetween calculations, logarithmic frequency rules and enabled/disabled block transitions, documenting confirmed units and constants per block.
- [ ] Compare actual interpolated fields and final body outputs against the native oracle across all 28 definitions, endpoints, transitions and varied coordinates.
